pageDescription: Status, groups, heartbeats, and active tasks. Anomaly count matches the Dashboard (neither Healthy nor Pending Login).

actions.selectAllOnPageAria: Select all accounts on this page

stats.abnormalHint: Needs code / frozen / invalid / dead / disabled

columns.healthUncheckedTooltip: Not probed yet: run Deep Probe once

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Use Bulk Import above to upload a phone list, StringSessions, .session files, or a tdata archive.

toasts.exportTruncated: Export exceeded 50,000 rows and was truncated; narrow your filters
toasts.selectAccountsForWarmup: Select accounts to warm up first
toasts.selectAccountsForThrottle: Select accounts to configure throttling first
toasts.profileAtLeastOneField: Fill in at least one profile field to update
toasts.profileSubmitted: Profile update task submitted to Worker

deleteConfirm.title: Delete account {{label}}?
deleteConfirm.content: This account and all its dialogs and message history will be permanently deleted.
deleteConfirm.phraseHint: High-risk action. Enter this account's identifier (phone / username / ID) to confirm.

bulkDelete.title: Bulk Delete Accounts ({{count}})
bulkDelete.alertDesc: Dialogs, messages, tasks, and leases for these accounts will all be permanently removed (audit logs remain unlinked).

appeal.title: Appeal Restriction (Official Flow)
appeal.alertDesc: Follows the standard user flow: open @SpamBot → send /start → read verdict → tap "This is a mistake" if available → record outcome. Limited to once per 24h per account; result updates account status.
appeal.withWarmup: Run one official warmup round after appeal (mimics normal user activity)

warmup.title: Official Warmup
warmup.alertTitle: Queue official-pace activity for {{count}} selected accounts
warmup.alertDesc: Matches official client behavior: go online → browse dialogs → go offline. Never sends messages or joins groups. Read receipts and typing indicators are off by default.
warmup.readInbox: Mark messages read (more human-like, visible to peers)
warmup.typing: Show typing indicator (visible to peers, use with caution)
warmup.syncLimits: Sync official server limits (only tightens throttling, never relaxes)

probe.title: Deep Probe
probe.alertTitle: Queue deep probe for {{count}} selected accounts
probe.alertDesc: Inspects account status, dialog list, and authorized sessions to recompute a 0-100 health score shown in the Health column.
probe.writeProbe: Also run a write probe (sends a test note to Saved Messages)

throttle.title: Configure Send Throttling
throttle.alertTitle: Apply throttling settings to {{count}} selected accounts
throttle.alertDesc: Daily message quota is disabled globally. Leave min action interval blank to keep unchanged; enter 0 to revert to automatic age-based tiers.
throttle.resetFlood: Clear circuit-breaker cooldown and flood counters (check only if recovered)
throttle.warmupNow: Reset warmup start to today (applies strictest tier for new accounts)

importModal.title: Bulk Import Accounts

tips.phone: One phone number per line, optionally followed by a comma and remark. Log in via verification code after import.
tips.session_string: One Telethon StringSession per line. Also supports `phone,session` or `session,remark`.
tips.session_file: Select one or more .session files (Telethon / Pyrogram SQLite sessions) to convert into StringSessions.
tips.tdata: Upload a zip archive of Telegram Desktop's tdata folder. One archive may contain multiple accounts.

importModal.tdataUnavailableHint: opentele2 is not installed in this environment, so tdata conversion is unavailable. Use .session files or Code Login instead.
importModal.needInputWarning: Paste entries or select files first
importModal.parseFailedWarning: {{count}} entries failed to parse; check the highlighted reasons below
importModal.dragHint: Multiple files supported; click Preview Parsed to verify before importing
importModal.warmupHint: Start from strictest interval today (daily quota disabled)

createModal.title: New Account
createModal.alert: Creating an account does not log in automatically; obtain a session via verification code.

editModal.title: Edit Group / Proxy: {{label}}
editModal.hint: Groups are custom tags; proxy is the fixed outbound endpoint read by the Worker on lease claim.

profileModal.title: Edit Profile: {{label}}
profileModal.alert: Updates this account's own Telegram profile name and avatar via the Worker holding its lease.
profileModal.avatarTooltip: Pick an image from Materials (recommended), or provide an image URL below

bulkActionModal.targetGroupLabel: Target Group (clear to remove from group)
bulkActionModal.targetGroupPlaceholder: Leave blank to remove from group
bulkActionModal.notReadySelected: Select accounts in the list first
bulkActionModal.notReadyAll: No accounts match the current filters
bulkActionModal.hintCheckOrSync: Creates one task per account for the Worker to execute; capped at 200 per batch.
bulkActionModal.hintDisable: Disabling releases leases and disconnects these accounts; you can re-enable anytime.
bulkActionModal.hintReleaseLease: Only clears leases without changing status; Workers will reclaim on the next cycle.
bulkActionModal.hintDefault: Per-account results will be shown in a dialog once complete.

bulkResult.title: Bulk Action Results
bulkResult.truncatedTitle: Matched count exceeded batch limit; only the first portion was processed
bulkResult.truncatedDesc: Narrow the scope by group/status filter or select accounts in smaller batches.

loginWizard.operationFailed: Operation failed. Please try again later.
loginWizard.deliveryAppTitle: Code was sent to the Telegram app, not SMS
loginWizard.deliveryAppWithNext: Open an active Telegram client for this account and check the official "Telegram" chat (777000). Telegram also offers "{{nextType}}" as fallback.
loginWizard.deliveryAppNoNext: Open an active Telegram client for this account and check the official "Telegram" chat (777000). Telegram did not offer SMS fallback; resending will only send to the app again. If no logged-in device is available, use QR Login instead.
loginWizard.deliveryOtherDesc: Check the delivery channel. If not received, wait for the cooldown and resend.
loginWizard.phoneRequired: Please enter the full phone number
loginWizard.phoneExtraExisting: May be left blank to use the encrypted number stored on the server; if filled, this value takes precedence. Telegram decides whether to send via SMS or Telegram app.
loginWizard.phoneExtraNew: Logs in this account directly without importing external session files. Telegram decides whether to send via SMS or Telegram app.
loginWizard.phonePlaceholderExisting: Leave blank to use stored number
loginWizard.codeExtra: Enter the code received by this account. Check the official "Telegram" chat (777000) in an active client if not received.
loginWizard.passwordExtra: This account has two-step verification enabled. Enter the password to complete login.
loginWizard.doneTip: Session encrypted and saved to tg_accounts.session_enc. Run Check Account to verify connectivity.

qrLogin.sessionExpired: QR login session expired; please generate a new code
qrLogin.queuedMessage: Queued QR code generation, please wait…
qrLogin.startFailed: Failed to generate QR code. Please try again later.
qrLogin.passwordFailed: Failed to submit password. Please retry.
qrLogin.doneDesc: Session encrypted and saved to the account. You can close this window.
qrLogin.doneDescWithPhone: Session encrypted and saved to the account ({{phone}}). You can close this window.
qrLogin.pendingTitleFallback: Scan with Telegram on your phone
qrLogin.refreshInSeconds: QR code refreshes automatically in {{seconds}}s. No manual action needed.
qrLogin.refreshSoon: QR code will refresh automatically soon. No manual action needed.
qrLogin.passwordRequiredTitle: Confirmed on phone; 2FA is enabled on this account
qrLogin.passwordRequiredDesc: Enter the two-step verification password. It is used only for this login and discarded immediately.
qrLogin.doneParagraph: Confirmed on phone. The Worker is saving the session; the list will refresh automatically.
qrLogin.instructions: Telegram Mobile → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device. Confirm on your phone; if 2FA is enabled, enter the password above afterward.
